title: DiskANN graph traversal with query-state View
hypothesis: A small query/task View specializes traversal on one shared SSD-resident DiskANN graph, preserving recall while improving the recall / SSD I/O / p99 tradeoff over native search_list_size tuning and a simple query-conditioned traversal gate.
physical_object: One official DiskANN graph and vector store on a directly measured SSD.
mirror_coordinate: Small query/task state m affecting graph traversal policy without changing graph topology.
logical_multiplicity: Task-specific retrieval traversal policies over one shared graph.
blocker: Container exposes virtual rotational vda and tmpfs, with no directly measurable SSD. DiskANN package/source and CMake/Ninja build tools are absent. SSD I/O/P99 hypothesis cannot be tested here.
success_gate: Not frozen: do not invent gates without the required DiskANN SSD runtime and data.
failure_gate: No model result; registry remains UNTESTED until a faithful experiment can be run.
boundaries: Feasibility blocker only; no ANN quality, storage or latency data.
Do not substitute an in-memory graph or unrelated ANN implementation for registered DiskANN SSD behavior.
